title: Shrink context window for Opus to reduce per-call input tokens
description:
The current context window is 40 recent + 20 summarized messages (CONTEXT_RECENT_COUNT=40, CONTEXT_SUMMARY_COUNT=20 in pilot.py). This was presumably tuned for cheaper models. Late-game Opus calls send 50-90k input tokens per call.

Opus might play just as well with a tighter window (e.g., 20 recent + 10 summarized), which would roughly halve per-call input tokens. The second half of the game (calls 249-497) cost $86 vs $51 for the first half, so shrinking the window has outsized impact on late-game costs.

This should be A/B tested — tighter context could hurt play quality if the model loses important game history. Consider making the window size configurable per-model in pilot config.
